mlsem.server.path.description: Path to MLsem LSP server executable.

mlsem.hover.overloadColors.description: In hovers of variables with several overloads, show a colour swatch per overload and tint the matching part of its `val` line in the editor while the hover is shown.

mlsem.llm.anthropic.markdownDescription:
Claude models used by `MLsem: Infer type with LLM` through Anthropic's native API, which reports thinking tokens, takes an effort per model and caches the prompt across tries. A model is a name, or `{ "model": ..., "effort": ... }` to use it at an effort (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`) instead of its default; the same model may be listed at several efforts. The key is set with `MLsem: Set LLM API key`, or taken from `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an `ant auth login` profile.

Example: `{ "models": ["claude-haiku-5-5", { "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "effort": "low" }] }`

mlsem.llm.providers.markdownDescription:
OpenAI-compatible endpoints used by `MLsem: Infer type with LLM`. Each provider's API key is set with `MLsem: Set LLM API key`.

Example: `{ "openai": { "baseUrl": "https://api.openai.com/v1", "models": ["gpt-5-mini"] } }`

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.

models.description: Models of the provider offered in the type toolkit.

mlsem.llm.maxTries.description: How many answers `MLsem: Infer type with LLM` asks for before giving up. Each rejected answer is sent back to the LLM with the type errors.

mlsem.llm.timeoutCountsAsFail.description: When an answer's type check times out: if on, it counts as a failed try and the LLM is asked again; if off, the inference stops there.

mlsem.trace.server.description: Trace setting of the MLsem language server.
